certification_on_chain.description: Cache of CertificationNFT data minted on the OGCR chain (chain id 20253). One record per certificate_of_compliance_id (a re-certification is a new certificate and a new record), populated by OGCR-chain-cache reading the chain.

certificate_of_compliance_id.description: Links to the `certificate_of_compliance` dynamic entity. The on-chain CertificationNFT is keyed by this id.

token_id.description: CertificationNFT token id minted for this certificate.

certificate_of_compliance_uri.description: certificate_of_compliance_uri stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certificate_of_compliance entity.

certificate_of_compliance_hash.description: certificate_of_compliance_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certificate_of_compliance entity body.

activity_id.description: activity_id of the certified activity as stored on-chain.

activity_nft_id.description: ActivityNFT token id this certification references (stored on-chain).

activity_uri.description: activity_uri stored on-chain: link back to the OBP activity entity.

activity_hash.description: activity_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw activity entity body.

certification_scheme_name.description: Certification scheme name as stored on-chain.

certification_scheme_uri.description: certification_scheme_uri stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certification_scheme entity.

certification_scheme_hash.description: certification_scheme_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certification_scheme entity body.

certification_body_name.description: Certification body name as stored on-chain.

certification_body_uri.description: certification_body_uri stored on-chain: link back to the OBP certification_body entity.

certification_body_hash.description: certification_body_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw certification_body entity body.

issue_date.description: Certification issue date as stored on-chain.

expiry_date.description: Certification expiry date as stored on-chain.

audit_report_uri.description: audit_report_uri stored on-chain: link back to the OBP audit_report entity.

audit_report_hash.description: audit_report_hash stored on-chain: keccak256 of the raw audit_report entity body.

carbon_removals_under_baseline.description: carbon_removals_under_baseline as recorded on the certificate: a decimal string in tonnes CO2e. Empty when the certificate carries no value.

soil_emissions_under_baseline.description: soil_emissions_under_baseline as recorded on the certificate: a decimal string in tonnes CO2e. Empty when the certificate carries no value.

permanent_net_carbon_removal_benefit.description: permanent_net_carbon_removal_benefit as recorded on the certificate: a decimal string in tonnes CO2e. Empty when the certificate carries no value.

carbon_farming_temporary_net_carbon_remo.description: carbon_farming_temporary_net_carbon_removal_benefit as recorded on the certificate: a decimal string in tonnes CO2e. Empty when the certificate carries no value.

carbon_farming_net_soil_emission_reducti.description: carbon_farming_net_soil_emission_reduction_benefit as recorded on the certificate: a decimal string in tonnes CO2e. Empty when the certificate carries no value.

carbon_storage_temporary_net_carbon_remo.description: carbon_storage_temporary_net_carbon_removal_benefit as recorded on the certificate: a decimal string in tonnes CO2e. Empty when the certificate carries no value.

unit_types.description: Unit types of the certificate as stored on-chain.

owner_address.description: Current owner of the NFT (operator OGCR wallet address).

token_uri.description: tokenURI of the NFT (ERC721 metadata data-URI).

contract_address.description: CertificationNFT contract address the token was read from.

tx_hash.description: Mint transaction hash (from the CertificationMinted event).

block_number.description: Block number the mint was included in.
